releaseEvidence: This describes reviewed source, not a deployed release. Verify the exact merged tree, canonical migrations and both production deployment responses before treating it as live.
confirmedSyntheticFailures: The actual OpenAI Usage route omitted the oldest eligible event above its 10,000-row limit, understating requests/tokens/errors without disclosing truncation. This is not evidence that the current production dataset exceeded the limit.
The actual Usage page displayed zero/no tracked requests after a failed initial load; a late seven-day reply could replace the selected ninety-day result.
The actual SPC Statistics route and aggregator omitted eligible fixture and enquiry records above their 5,000-row limits. This is not a claim of current live undercounting.

Expired Statistics cache and explicit refresh failures returned old figures as HTTP 200 with no body disclosure. Initial page failure rendered multiple NO DATA sections despite having no verified report.
The Statistics chart grid clipped right-hand figures on narrow phones; its tables also shortened names and values.
scopedRepairs: OpenAI Usage uses a complete read-only database snapshot for supported fixed-second periods, exact totals/page shares and deterministic recent events; unsupported unsafe numeric totals fail clearly instead of rounding silently.
SPC Statistics reads all required non-secret inputs from one stable database snapshot. An explicit complete-read resource budget fails without partial figures, rather than silently truncating rows.
Existing financial parsing, imported/native classification, per-grade counts, trader/office assignment precedence, selected-year and ninety-day reporting semantics are preserved and parity-tested.

Statistics never reports an expired failed refresh as successful. Both pages validate responses, distinguish unavailable from verified empty data, label retained verified values and ignore replies from former request/session owners.
Access denial clears retained data before parsing even a non-JSON error reply; existing View/Edit and signed-out authorization remain unchanged.

Statistics has keyboard-accessible internal chart/table scrolling and a narrow-phone grid that keeps full figures reachable. Safe local usage page links remain links; API and unsafe legacy path values are plain text, never omitted from totals.
Hosted release checks include the analytics API/SQL regressions and isolated Chromium/WebKit desktop/mobile state matrices without adding production dependencies or credentials.
preservedBoundaries: New functions are read-only, stable, security-invoker, empty-search-path and service-role-only with bounded statement timeouts; existing tables, data, RLS, triggers and indexes are unchanged.
No prices, notices, contacts, templates, suppliers, enquiries, fixtures, credentials, permissions, provider keys or usage events are edited for testing.
No email, reminder, sync, backup, recovery, provider request, retention, cost-control, Exchange worker, dependency or federation change is included.
Taiwan general remarks still wait for the separate Publish action; previously deployed user choices and repairs remain intact.
requiredReleaseChecks: Freeze the exact source and verify it remains unchanged through broad TypeScript, SQL/native PostgreSQL, browser, type, lint, build, font, contract and worker-preservation gates.
Check 320px and 390px phones plus desktop, Chromium and WebKit, both OS color preferences, affected View/Edit/denied/signed-out states and internal scrolling.
Independent implementation and review tests must agree, including concurrent commits, over-limit datasets, resource-budget failures and unchanged business formulas.
Production dependency audit must pass; retain full-audit failure evidence only for the unchanged standing-authorized development-tool advisory.

Use the exact canonical 138-migration history plus only these two reviewed append-only files; verify read-only privileges and unchanged business records before and after applying them to the pinned FCUNO project.
Promote only the exact tested staged production build, verify both public hostnames and affected signed-in read-only views, then close only owned browser tabs.
verificationLimits: Synthetic scale and concurrency tests do not prove production volume or latency; live post-release read-only checks remain required.
Physical iPhone and Android devices are not tested. Both OS color preferences are tested against the existing fixed-light admin palette, not a new dark theme.

The rest of the sitewide requirement matrix, full isolated backup restoration and previously recorded business decisions remain unfinished. No pre-migration backup is claimed to cover these new functions.
